name: ifiokjr/monosecret
description: PHP SDK for Monosecret, a declarative secrets manager. A thin client over the shared Rust resolver; sources live in php/monosecret_php/.

suggest.ext-ffi: Zero-install backend (set ffi.enable for web/FPM); run vendor/bin/monosecret-install-lib to fetch the native library
suggest.ext-monosecret-php-native: Native extension that embeds the resolver; works under FPM with no ffi.enable (see https://ifiokjr.github.io/monosecret/sdk/php)
